sloka: सुहृदां हितकामानां न श्रुतं वचनं त्वया ।भ्रातऽणां चापि कार्त्स्न्येन हितमुक्तं त्वया ऽनघ ।। ६.११४.७६ ।।
transliteration: suhṛdāṁ hitakāmānāṁ na śrutaṁ vacanaṁ tvayā ।bhrāta'ṇāṁ cāpi kārtsnyena hitamuktaṁ tvayā 'nagha ।। 6.114.76 ।।

translations.english: "You are famous for your strength and courage. I do not need to wail for you. Being a woman, by nature I am compassionate, and my mind is moving towards sorrow."
